# HAPI v0.25.1.1

Compared with the previous maintained release, this build rebases the maintenance line onto official HAPI v0.25.1.

Compared with the official release, it carries selected upstream fixes including PRs #869, #912, #955, #997, #1009, #906, #1029, #1150, #1113, #1094, #1087, #958, #1188, and #1189, plus the fork release, cache, signing, and collaboration safeguards.
